dominant_peak_arithmetic.interpretation: Recomputes the dominant h=32 peak row from exact RM min-weight count, exact first-gap placement numerator/denominator, and the checked T=5949,H=31 inner knot value.

dominant_prefix_inflation.interpretation: Thresholded audit that the dominant peak row controls the entire exact-RM-reweighted prefix family.

dominant_prefix_row.interpretation: After exact RM outer reweighting, the checked prefix family is peak-dominated by the h=32, first_r=1, gap=1..4000 row.

eallratio_branch_semantics.rule: fixed-pole eallratio branch dominates exact finite selected-gap Chernoff sums in audit samples

eallratio_tail_semantics.rule: R_{H,T} truncation is closed by a decreasing-ratio geometric tail bound

endpoint_gap_sum_semantics.rule: sum over a gap bucket is bounded by bucket_size times the right-endpoint binomial

late_postprefix_shape.shape_rule: adjacent ratio ((m-h)/(N-h))/z is decreasing, so each row is checked at endpoints and the critical point

late_prefix_exact_outer_thresholds.interpretation: Thresholded audit for the ultra-late prefix T<late_blocks using exact RM direct-sum outer coefficients and placement-only late probability.

postprefix_h501_plus_thresholds.interpretation: Thresholded audit for the h>=501 row-family aggregate. The 501..2000 all-episode CSV aggregate dominates the h>=501 remainder; all other post-prefix and high-weight covers are far below it.

prefix_ridge_ratio.interpretation: Shape audit for the first-r/gap=1..4000 prefix ridge. The placement component has a separate exact cross-multiplication certificate.

t_monotonicity_sufficient_reduction.rule: two-case sufficient endpoint reduction for fixed-pole e>=1 envelope monotonicity in T
